action.focusLeft: Go to the pane on the left
action.focusRight: Go to the pane on the right
pane.exited: The program ended with code {code}. Press Enter to start it again.
confirm.closeBody: A program is still running. Closing stops it, and anything it has not saved is lost.
error.noProfile: There is no profile to open. Add one in Settings › Profiles.
error.write: Could not send to the program: {detail}.
error.badLink: Only web and email links are opened.
paste.sudoTitle: Paste a command that runs as administrator?
paste.body: Pasted lines may run as soon as they arrive. Check them first.
palette.placeholder: Type a command, profile or theme
notice.fileBroken: The settings file has a mistake, so the last good settings are in use.
notice.problems: Some settings were not understood and use their defaults: {names}.
settings.newTabsInCurrentFolder: Open new tabs and panes in the current folder
settings.newTabsInCurrentFolderHint: Needs shell integration, which tells the app the folder.
settings.confirmClose: Ask before closing a running program
settings.confirmCloseHint: For example an editor or a build that is still running.
settings.confirmCloseHintWindows: Windows does not tell which programs are running, so the app cannot always ask.
settings.confirmPasteHint: Also before pasting a command with sudo.
settings.copyOnSelect: Copy text as soon as it is selected
settings.rightClickPasteHint: With text selected it copies, otherwise it pastes. Off: right-click shows a menu.
settings.optionIsMetaHint: For shortcuts in shells and editors. Option then no longer types special characters.
settings.followSystem: Follow the system's light or dark look
settings.followSystemHint: Uses one theme in light mode and another in dark mode.
settings.pickLight: Choose the theme for light mode:
settings.pickDark: Choose the theme for dark mode:
settings.accentHint: For the active tab, buttons and focus. Empty: the theme's colour.
settings.fontHint: Any installed monospace font. Several can be listed, separated by commas.
settings.ligaturesHint: Draws => or != as one symbol when the font has it.
theme.copied: The theme is copied as JSON.
theme.importBad: This file is not a KS Forge theme.
profile.intro: A profile is a shell or program with its own folder, theme and icon. Shells found on this computer are added by themselves.
profile.name: Name
profile.programHint: The full path, or a name found in PATH.
profile.argsHint: Separated by spaces; use quotes for spaces inside one.
profile.shellIntegrationHint: Lets the app know the folder and mark each command, for zsh, bash, fish and PowerShell. Your own startup files still run first.
profile.removeBody: Tabs already open with it stay open.
keys.intro: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc stops without a change.
keys.clash: Another action has the same shortcut.
about.tagline: A fast, private terminal for macOS and Windows. Part of KS-Suite.
about.privacy: Free, with no ads, no analytics and no account. The only request the app makes by itself is the daily update check, which you can turn off.
about.licence: MIT licence. Built with Tauri, xterm.js, portable-pty, React and Lucide.
confirm.quitBody: A program is still running in one of the windows. Quitting stops it, and anything it has not saved is lost.
settings.restoreSessionHint: At start, the windows, tabs and folders of the last time come back. Programs start fresh.
